entries.title: Thanksgiving on The Row

entries.title: Friends of the Milpitas Library Big Winter Book Sale
entries.description: All books are 50% off every Sunday.\nAmazon Sales\nWe have a large catalog of books for sale on Amazon, and we try to offer the lowest price for every title that we list.

entries.priorDescriptionZh: Amazon 图书销售：我们在 Amazon 上提供大量书籍，并尽力为每本上架图书提供最低价格。

entries.title: Little Explorers: Wonderful Winter!
entries.description: nbsp;We may not have snow, but we can still play in a wintery way, with a variety of snowy-themed crafts and play activities.Little Explorers is a monthly creativity-based program for families with toddlers and preschoolers.nbsp;nbsp;nbsp;Join us on the first Friday of the month to explore new ways to play and learn!

entries.priorDescriptionZh: 即使没有下雪，也可以通过多种冰雪主题手工和游戏体验冬季。

entries.priorDescriptionZh: 喜欢 LEGO 积木的孩子可以自由发挥，搭建作品。

entries.title: Once Upon a Garden (family night)
entries.description: Through the Looking Glass Woodland Garden Wander through Faerie Village Meet and pose for photos with Santa and his sleigh, storybook characters, and a queen on stilts Delight in children’s crafts and holiday shopping Head to the Gnome Nom Cafe for hot chocolate and a sweet treat Storytime and refreshments under the Big Top Adults enjoy a complimentary glass of champagne We’ve decked the halls and strung up the lights, so come visit, shop, and enjoy the festivities!
entries.priorTitleZh: Once Upon a Garden（家庭之夜）
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 漫步 Faerie Village，与圣诞老人及雪橇、故事人物和踩高跷的节日仙子合影；参加儿童手工及节日购物；到 Gnome Nom Cafe 享用热巧克力和饼干。成人可获赠一杯香槟。现场布置了节日灯饰，可参观、购物并享受节庆活动。

entries.title: Saturday Board Games Day
entries.description: The group meets every 1st Saturday from 10 AM–6 PM.nbsp;\nAttendees can bring their own games to play or jump-in with others.

entries.title: Baby Sign and Stay and Play
entries.description: Calling all non-walking babies ages 0-12 months for a special storytime featuring American Sign Language along with songs and stories and fun!

entries.title: Family BINGO
entries.description: nbsp;We will be running multiple rounds, so you can drop in and play anytime.
entries.priorTitleZh: 家庭 BINGO 宾果游戏
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 活动进行多轮，大家可以随时到场参与。

entries.title: Holiday Jazz Music
entries.description: Join us for MAK Band Jazz, a special sing-along performance of holiday favorites.\nThis band is an ensemble featuring guitar, ukulele, trumpet, tenor saxophone, alto saxophone, clarinet, trombone, bass, drums, harmonica and percussion, along with special guest jazz musicians.They will perform popular holiday music, including songs such as "Jingle Bells," "Frosty the Snowman," "Let It Snow," “Rockin’ Around the Christmas Tree,” and others.\nThis is a family program.
entries.priorTitleZh: 节日爵士音乐
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 将演奏《Jingle Bells》《Frosty the Snowman》《Let It Snow》《Rockin’ Around the Christmas Tree》等热门节日歌曲。

entries.title: Teen Rubik's Cube Club
entries.description: Meet other cubers, learn new techniques, and have fun!

entries.title: Baby Sign and Sing
entries.description: Join us for Sign and Sing for Babies in our first floor program room!
entries.priorTitleZh: 婴儿手语与歌唱
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 成年照护者将学习与宝宝交流所需的基础手语。

entries.title: Poetry in the Dark
entries.description: This December, join us for a dimly lit evening of shared poetry at the Cupertino Library.nbsp;Voices of all ages, cultures, and languages come together to share the power of the spoken and written word.nbsp;Each participant may read their poem(s) aloud to their group.nbsp;Hosted by Thomas Célérier - Cupertino Poet LaureateAll are welcome.No prior experience necessary.
